in_sanskrit.name: हार्सिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is adorned with wealth, happiness, and good fortune.

in_hindi.name: हारसिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name derived from the word 'Har' meaning god Shiva and 'Sita' meaning the goddess of wealth, signifying the one who is blessed with the prosperity and wealth of both Shiva and Sita.

in_tamil.name: ஹார்சிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: A name meaning one who is fortunate, prosperous, or blessed.

in_telugu.name: హార్సితా
in_telugu.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit term 'Shodashyaeshya', meaning one who is pleasing to sixteen gods and goddesses, symbolizing her all-round blessings and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Haarsita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haarsita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Haarsita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'haarsayate' which means 'desirable' or 'lovable'. It is a name that evokes feelings of warmth, affection, and attraction. In Hindu mythology, Haarsita is associated with the goddess of love, Saraswati, and symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and beauty.
